# The hall (generated by make_env.py): floor, ruined side walls with doorways and dark passages, the
# far wall with the great gate, roof beams. glTF frame: the player at the origin looking down -Z.
new
material new Floor --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new Wall --base-color 0.3216 0.3255 0.2980 --no-slot
material new Dark --base-color 0.1490 0.1255 0.1137 --no-slot
material new Trim --base-color 0.5608 0.5765 0.5373 --no-slot
material new Gloom --base-color 0.3490 0.1882 0.5176 --no-slot
material new Rune --base-color 0.3412 0.6235 0.7059 --no-slot
add mesh plane --name Floor --size 1 --location 0.000 10.000 0.000
scale 13.000 28.000 1
apply --scale
material assign Floor
active Floor
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Floor base-color textures/floor.png
add mesh cube --name W0 --size 1 --location -6.900 -3.517 3.155
scale 0.800 0.967 6.309
apply --scale
material assign Wall
active W0
mode edit
select face where "normal.x < -0.5 || normal.z > 0.5 || normal.z < -0.5 || normal.y < -0.5 || normal.y > 0.5"
delete face
mode object
